items.say: Pounce the cat found a green potion by the river. Puff the dragon found a red torch. Then they swapped, just for fun. What does Puff have now?
Hoot the owl was carrying a sword up the hill. Zip the robot was carrying a shield. Dash the fox waved at them from the top. Halfway up, Hoot and Zip swapped. Who is carrying the sword now?
Hoot the owl had two chests, a yellow one and a green one. Zazz the wizard had none. So Hoot gave Zazz the yellow one and kept the other. Which chest does Hoot have now?

Pounce the cat and Zazz the wizard went to a picnic by the lake. Pounce brought a purple hat, and Zazz brought a green torch. When it was time to go home, they each picked up the wrong thing by mistake. What did Pounce take home?
Pounce the cat found a purple rocket behind the castle. Boo the ghost found a red map. Pounce liked the map better, and Boo liked the rocket better, so they swapped. What does Boo have now?

Dash the fox was carrying a drum up the hill. Zip the robot was carrying a chest. Pounce the cat walked behind them, carrying nothing at all. Halfway up, Dash and Zip swapped. Who is carrying the drum now?
Sir Clank the knight had two chests, a green one and a yellow one. Zip the robot had none. So Sir Clank gave Zip the green one and kept the other. Which chest does Sir Clank have now?
